source: FM3-Edit exports of one FM3 factory preset with parallel rows: from its factory location and again after the user's STORE to test location 427. Only the record order and the grid shape are recorded here; the preset file and its values are not in the repo.

rows: In 1 | synth | - | - | mixer4<1+2+3 | ringmod | amp | cab | delay | reverb | Out 1 | .
grid.note: Blocks on rows 2 and 3 (wah2, mixer) take the same fixed record order as row-1 blocks: the order does not follow grid position.
